decisionsTitle: The members filter is a tick, and so is the bounced one: two selects that said «Toate evenimentele» for nothing (amending §312, §581)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-03, with a phone screenshot of the registrations list's filter row:** «Asta nu merge corect, ar trebui să fie bifă separată cu „membrii Brașov Runners”.»

**What was wrong.** The members' filter (`clubMember`) and the bounced filter (`bounced`) were two-option selects. Closed, MUI shows a select's label inside the box, so «Membri {club} ▾» read as a value already chosen; opened, its empty option was the events select's «Toate evenimentele» (§312), which speaks of events, not of members. The bounced select had the same empty option under the label «Email», and so had the status select «Stare». The promo filter beside them was already a tick («Doar cu oferte și beneficii», §581) and read right. And the list never drew the «Email respins» chip that BR-REQ-038-01 criterion 8 promised it would (§83): only the desk, the registration's page and the export showed a bounce, so a row kept by the bounced filter carried nothing that said why.

**Decision.** Both become a `CheckboxField` of the promo tick's kind — dense, a glyph first, a help line under it:

- «Doar membrii {club} (declarați)» / "Only {club} members (declared)", with the members' card glyph the site uses for the club's members (§552); help: who ticked «Sunt membru al grupului {club}» at registration; the club does not check; the row reads «Membru (declarat)». `{club}` is `CLUB_NAME`.
- «Doar cine nu a primit emailul» / "Only those the email never reached", with an email-off glyph; help: the address bounced the message or the provider refused it (§76, §83); the row reads «Email respins»; these are the people to call before the race.

The list's row now draws that «Email respins» chip — the desk's own, the provider's reason as its hover text — whenever the registration has a bounced or complained message (the same reading the filter and the export use, a club copy excepted), so the help's words are true on the screen they sit on. The status select's empty option says «Toate stările» / "All statuses" (`registrations.statusAll`), and `filterAll` is read by the events select alone.

Ticked submits `1`, unticked submits nothing — the same parameters as before, so the filter in `admin-repository.ts`, the exports, the summary pills (§626) and the member sweep (it opens only with `clubMember=1`) are untouched. The two selects' keys `clubMemberLabel` and `bouncedLabel` are gone. The guide's step for the member sweep now says to tick the box by its words, filled with `CLUB_NAME` by the guide page.

**Refused.** A three-way select (all / members / not members): nobody asked for a list of non-members, and «declarat» is the row's own word — a filter can keep only what the person said. «Not a member» is not something the form records: an unticked box is "did not say", and `club-member.test.ts` keeps `false` out of the filter for that reason. Words and markup only: no migration, no dependency.
changelogLine: - **Members and bounced filters are ticks.** On «Înscrieri», «Doar membrii {club} (declarați)» and «Doar cine nu a primit emailul» are checkboxes with a help line, like «Doar cu oferte și beneficii», instead of selects whose closed box showed the label as if it were a chosen value; the filtering, the export and the member sweep are unchanged. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the registrations list, when its filter row renders in either language, then the members' filter and the bounced filter are each a tick with a glyph and a help line, like «Doar cu oferte și beneficii» — «Doar membrii <club> (declarați)» (`clubMember=1`, the club's name from `CLUB_NAME`) and «Doar cine nu a primit emailul» (`bounced=1`) — ticked exactly when their parameter is `1`, with no select and no empty option borrowed from the events select; the status select's empty option is «Toate stările», not «Toate evenimentele»; the filtering, the exports and the member sweep read the same parameters as before (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registrations list, when an Administrator ticks «Doar cine nu a primit emailul» (`bounced=1`) — the tick that replaces criterion 8's «doar email respins» option — then the list keeps the registrations with a bounced or complained message, a club copy excepted, and every list row of such a registration, filtered or not, carries the same «Email respins» chip the desk row and the registration's page draw, the provider's short reason as its hover text (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the members and bounced filters are ticks
